title: Rundll32 invokes inline script through MSHTML
description: Detects rundll32 command lines that invoke JavaScript or VBScript through the MSHTML RunHTMLApplication export.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use rundll32 and MSHTML to execute inline script through a trusted Windows binary.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents the JavaScript MSHTML RunHTMLApplication pattern under Rundll32 proxy execution; requiring the script prefix, MSHTML and named export keeps the process-only predicate narrow.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify rundll32 commands that combine an inline JavaScript or VBScript prefix with MSHTML and RunHTMLApplication while leaving ordinary rundll32 use and incomplete fragments unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Recover the complete inline script and process ancestry, then determine what content was loaded or executed.
steps: Review the complete command line, account, device, binary path and initiating process.
Inspect network connections, loaded content, child processes and files created around the event.
Confirm an authorized test or administrative explanation; isolate the device and preserve script content when the chain is unexplained.
false_positives: Authorized security testing or rare administrative diagnostics that deliberately exercise the documented pattern

validation.expected_outcome: Match rundll32 inline JavaScript or VBScript through MSHTML RunHTMLApplication; do not match ordinary exports, partial fragments, other binaries or incomplete events.
